name: Agent Session History
description: Reads part of a session's history, every entry exactly as stored: turns, tool calls, full tool results, diagnostics and compaction summaries. A missing or hidden session returns {found:false}.

agentId.description: The agent to read, as an id or g/<id> path. Required unless you are that agent. Naming another agent needs read access to it.

sessionId.description: The session to read, as 16-byte hex with or without 0x. If omitted: the session you are in, or outside a session the newest visible one.

start.description: Position of the first entry to read; 0 is the oldest. If omitted: as many entries as limit allows, ending at end. To continue after a result with next, pass next here.

end.description: Position to stop before; that entry is not read. If omitted or past the last entry: the end of the history. To read further back, pass here the start of your last read, which the result gives if you passed none. For a compaction summary naming turns a to b, use start=a and end=b+1.

limit.description: Most entries to return. Default 20. It counts entries, not size: each entry comes back whole.

found.description: False when the session is missing or hidden; no other field is then present.

start.description: Present only when the input had no start: the position of the first entry returned.

next.description: Present only when the range held more than limit entries: the position to continue from.

entries.description: The stored entries, unchanged, oldest first. entries[i] is at position start + i, with start as passed or returned.
